decisions.reason: {{NRDB species}} is the sole content of <ref name=RDB> and supplies the full citation of the source (a Reptile Database entry), so it is a template whose purpose is to format a citation, the 'and similar' case of 3.1. Locked label counts it as a citation template and is right. Ambiguous: the render is a bare external link with no citation markup, so a narrow reading that counts only Cite-family templates would exclude it. I followed the guide's purpose wording.
